title: Warning: High-Quality Counterfeit 200 MAD Notes Found in Marrakech — How to Check
body:
Marrakech police seized 15,000+ MAD in counterfeit 200 MAD notes after a Gueliz restaurant cashier raised an alert. Two suspects arrested. The fake notes are described as high-quality and difficult to detect without UV equipment.

How to Check Notes

Tilt the note to see colour-shifting security ink. Hold to light for the watermark and embedded strip. Feel for raised print on the denomination numeral. Get cash only from official bank branches or licensed exchange offices. A UV detector costs under 200 MAD at Marrakech stationery shops.

Source: Kech24, Marrakech police.
